definition: A helpful E.L.F. — one that inhabits a system and improves its function. Named after the Scottish household spirit. A Brownie in your targeting aug means shots land true. A Brownie in your medical implant means better diagnostics. The E.L.F. everyone wants and nobody can summon.
origin: E.L.F. classification — from Scottish folklore, where brownies cleaned the house while the family slept
example: This aug has a brownie in it. I swear. Accuracy went up 12% after the firmware glitch last month.
